status: Exploratory independent-DNS calibration; retrospective Hussein holdout. Not production qualified.

calibration.selection: First 26 axial-DNS blocks in Figure 2a, collectively labeled x/D=15..40. Deduplicate identical blocks and use all remaining curves equally; individual block-to-station mapping is not asserted. Exclude the short experimental overlays and all radial-velocity curves. Source file has blank-separated numeric blocks, despite README mentioning headings.
calibration.license_notice: Source landing page and README specify CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; retain raw data only in ignored research outputs. No source tables are redistributed.
calibration.deduplication: Remove exact duplicate numeric arrays among selected blocks before interpolation; keep the first occurrence. This is a source-export correction, not a profile/holdout selection.

fit.objective: Equal-weight squared error in U/Uc on the common eta grid, averaged across all unique selected DNS curves; do not clip negative/noisy source values. No Hussein/waterjet data are opened by calibration.
fit.selection: Minimum DNS objective among these fixed starts; retain every optimizer result. Mixture is a positive empirical shape representation, not a derived Reynolds-stress closure.

assessment.holdout: Unchanged reference.json Hussein targets and 20% local-relative engineering screen
assessment.integrals: I1=integral eta*f d_eta; I2=integral eta*f^2 d_eta. DNS alpha=I1/sqrt(2 I2); retain the derived integral normalization, not an independently imposed Uc or width.
assessment.report: All candidates, source-fit residuals, finite-plane/conservation tests and applicability limits. No selection based on holdout results.

revision_history: Revision 1: job 30272238, all 26 exported axial blocks used. It passed numerical tests but failed every holdout screen.

Revision 2: remove exact duplicate block 1 (identical to block 0). Selection, fit families, bounds, initial guesses and holdout criteria unchanged. Report the source-versus-holdout spread without refitting.
